ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit affiliate disabling EDR/AV via PowerShell + tampering with Defender exclusions pre-encryption
ucs.description: LockBit affiliates (tracked by Microsoft as Storm-0506/Storm-1175 clusters and by Mandiant overlapping with UNC4393/FIN7-adjacent operators) consistently disable Defender, stop AV/backup services, and add sweeping exclusion paths via PowerShell `Set-MpPreference` and `sc.exe stop` immediately before staging LockBit.exe/LockBit Black. This hunts that pre-encryption defense-evasion sequence on a single host.

ucs.kql:
// LockBit pre-encryption defense-evasion stack: disable Defender + kill AV/backup services + nuke shadow copies
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let EvasionProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","taskkill.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "Set-MpPreference","DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableBehaviorMonitoring",
        "DisableIOAVProtection","DisableScriptScanning","MpPreference -Exclusion",
        "Add-MpPreference","Uninstall-WindowsFeature","Windows-Defender")
       or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("WinDefend","Sense","WdNisSvc","SecurityHealthService","MsMpSvc","SQLWriter","VeeamBackupSvc","BackupExecAgentAccelerator"))
       or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("vssadmin","wmic") and ProcessCommandLine has "shadow")
       or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures"))
       or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete backup","delete systemstatebackup"))
    | extend EvasionKind = case(
        ProcessCommandLine has "MpPreference", "DefenderTamper",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("WinDefend","Sense","WdNisSvc","MsMpSvc"), "AVServiceStop",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("VeeamBackupSvc","BackupExec","SQLWriter"), "BackupServiceStop",
        ProcessCommandLine has "shadow", "ShadowDelete",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy"), "RecoveryDisable",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete backup"), "BackupCatalogWipe",
        "Other");
EvasionProcs
| summarize DistinctEvasionKinds = dcount(EvasionKind),
            EvasionKinds = make_set(EvasionKind),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where DistinctEvasionKinds >= 2     // ≥2 distinct evasion *categories* in 30 min — LockBit's signature stack
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, AccountName, DistinctEvasionKinds, EvasionKinds, Parents, SampleCmds
| order by FirstSeen desc

| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|sc|vssadmin|bcdedit|wbadmin|wmic|net|taskkill)\.exe$/i

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit lateral movement via PsExec/SMB push of encryptor to ADMIN$/C$ shares with `-pAffID` style command line
ucs.description: Once domain-admin is obtained, LockBit affiliates (LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black/Green/5.0 — Microsoft Storm-0506, Mandiant UNC4393 cluster, BleepingComputer-tracked Bassterlord/National Hazard Agency affiliates) propagate the encryptor by copying `LB3.exe`/`locker.exe`/`<random>.exe` to remote `ADMIN$` or `C$` shares, then invoking via PsExec/WMI with the actor-specific `-pass`, `-id`, `-pAffID`, `-safe`, `-gdel`, or `-sh` switches that LockBit's builder hard-codes. This hunts the host-to-host fan-out signature.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.user) as user values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\ADMIN$\\*","*\\C$\\*","*\\C$\\Windows\\*","*\\C$\\PerfLogs\\*","*\\C$\\Users\\Public\\*") AND Filesystem.file_name IN ("*.exe","LB3.exe","locker.exe","lbb.exe","LockBit*.exe") by host Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")` | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("psexec.exe","psexesvc.exe","paexec.exe","wmic.exe","wmiprvse.exe") AND (Processes.process="*-pass*" OR Processes.process="*-pAffID*" OR Processes.process="*-id *" OR Processes.process="*-safe*" OR Processes.process="*-gdel*" OR Processes.process="*-sh*" OR Processes.process="*process call create*locker*" OR Processes.process="*process call create*LB3*") by host Processes.process Processes.user _time | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`] | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(file_path) as drops values(file_name) as files values(process) as exec_cmd values(user) as users dc(file_path) as distinct_remote_drops by host | where distinct_remote_drops >= 2 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// LockBit lateral push: encryptor written to remote ADMIN$/C$ via SMB + PsExec/WMI launch with LockBit-builder CLI switches
let WindowMinutes = 15m;
let RemoteWrites = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where RequestProtocol =~ "SMB"      // written from a remote host over admin share
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\ADMIN$\", @"\C$\", @"\C$\Windows\", @"\C$\PerfLogs\", @"\C$\Users\Public\")
    | where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project WriteTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256,
              RequestSourceIP, RequestAccountName, RequestAccountDomain;
let SuspiciousExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (FileName in~ ("psexec.exe","psexesvc.exe","paexec.exe","psexec64.exe")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-pass","-pAffID","-id ","-safe","-gdel","-sh","-accepteula"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "process call create")
         or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wmiprvse.exe" and FileName endswith ".exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-pass","-pAffID","-id ","-safe","-gdel"))
         or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "services.exe" and FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\") and FileName endswith ".exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-pass","-pAffID","-id ","-safe","-gdel"))
    | project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, ExecFile = FileName, ExecPath = FolderPath, ExecCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ExecParent = InitiatingProcessFileName, ExecUser = AccountName, ExecSrcIP = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).RemoteIP);
RemoteWrites
| join kind=inner SuspiciousExec on DeviceName
| where ExecTime between (WriteTime .. WriteTime + WindowMinutes)
| summarize DistinctTargets = dcount(DeviceName),
            TargetHosts = make_set(DeviceName, 20),
            DroppedFiles = make_set(FileName, 10),
            DropHashes = make_set(SHA256, 10),
            ExecCmds = make_set(ExecCmd, 10),
            FirstWrite = min(WriteTime),
            LastExec = max(ExecTime)
            by RequestSourceIP, RequestAccountName, bin(WriteTime, 1h)
| where DistinctTargets >= 2     // 2+ remote hosts pushed from same source = fan-out, not admin housekeeping
| project FirstWrite, LastExec, RequestSourceIP, RequestAccountName, DistinctTargets, TargetHosts, DroppedFiles, DropHashes, ExecCmds
| order by FirstWrite desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// LockBit lateral push on Sentinel: SMB file-share writes (4663/5145) followed by PsExec/WMI service-create (7045) carrying LockBit builder switches
let WindowMinutes = 15m;
let RemoteWrites = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 5145                       // detailed file-share access
    | where ObjectName has_any (@"\ADMIN$\", @"\C$\")
    | where ObjectName endswith ".exe" or ObjectName endswith ".dll"
    | where AccessMask has_any ("0x2","0x4","0x100","0x40") // write/append
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project WriteTime = TimeGenerated, TargetHost = Computer, ShareTargetFile = ObjectName,
              SrcIP = IpAddress, SrcUser = SubjectUserName, SrcDomain = SubjectDomainName;
let SuspiciousExec = union
    (SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where EventID == 4688
        | extend Img = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
        | where (Img in ("psexec.exe","psexesvc.exe","paexec.exe","psexec64.exe")
                 and CommandLine has_any ("-pass","-pAffID","-id ","-safe","-gdel","-sh"))
             or (Img == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "process call create")
             or (CommandLine has_any ("-pAffID","-pass ","-safe","-gdel") and NewProcessName has_any (@"\Windows\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\"))
        | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, TargetHost = Computer, ExecFile = NewProcessName,
                  ExecCmd = CommandLine, ExecParent = ParentProcessName, ExecUser = SubjectUserName),
    (SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where EventID == 7045                  // service install
        | where ServiceFileName has_any ("-pAffID","-pass ","-safe","-gdel",@"\PSEXESVC",@"\PAExec")
        | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, TargetHost = Computer, ExecFile = ServiceName,
                  ExecCmd = ServiceFileName, ExecParent = "services.exe", ExecUser = SubjectUserName);
RemoteWrites
| join kind=inner SuspiciousExec on TargetHost
| where ExecTime between (WriteTime .. WriteTime + WindowMinutes)
| summarize DistinctTargets = dcount(TargetHost),
            TargetHosts = make_set(TargetHost, 20),
            DroppedFiles = make_set(ShareTargetFile, 10),
            ExecCmds = make_set(ExecCmd, 10),
            FirstWrite = min(WriteTime),
            LastExec = max(ExecTime)
            by SrcIP, SrcUser, bin(WriteTime, 1h)
| where DistinctTargets >= 2
| project FirstWrite, LastExec, SrcIP, SrcUser, DistinctTargets, TargetHosts, DroppedFiles, ExecCmds
| order by FirstWrite desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Affiliate Encryptor Launch via PsExec with Builder-Specific Switches
id: 8a3c4b1f-7e9d-4c2a-9f6b-2d8e1f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects PsExec / WMI / service-installed binaries whose command line carries LockBit builder-specific flags (-pAffID, -pass, -id, -safe, -gdel, -sh). These switches are documented in CISA AA23-325A and Mandiant LockBit Black/5.0 reporting; legitimate admin use of PsExec does not include them.
references:
    - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-325a
    - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/lockbit-ransomware-analysis
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026-06-19
tags:
    - attack.impact
    - attack.lateral_movement
    - attack.t1486
    - attack.t1021.002
    - attack.t1569.002
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_lockbit_cli:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - ' -pAffID '
            - ' -pAffID='
            - ' -pass '
            - ' -id '
            - ' -safe '
            - ' -gdel'
            - ' -sh '
            - ' -wall'
    selection_context:
        - ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\psexec.exe'
            - '\psexesvc.exe'
            - '\paexec.exe'
            - '\wmiprvse.exe'
            - '\services.exe'
        - Image|contains:
            - '\PerfLogs\'
            - '\Users\Public\'
            - '\Windows\Temp\'
            - '\ProgramData\'
        - Image|endswith:
            - '\LB3.exe'
            - '\locker.exe'
            - '\lbb.exe'
    condition: selection_lockbit_cli and selection_context
falsepositives:
    - Custom internal tooling that happens to use identically-named short flags (vanishingly rare)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@ParentImage:(*\psexec.exe OR *\PsExec.exe OR *\PSEXEC.EXE OR *\psexesvc.exe OR *\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\paexec.exe OR *\wmiprvse.exe OR *\WmiPrvSE.exe OR *\services.exe) OR @Image:(*\PerfLogs\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\Windows\Temp\* OR *\ProgramData\*\*.exe)) AND @CommandLine:(*\ -pAffID* OR *\ -pass\ * OR *\ -id\ * OR *\ -safe* OR *\ -gdel* OR *\ -sh\ * OR *\ -wall*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ParentBaseFileName=/^(psexec|psexesvc|paexec|wmiprvse|services)\.exe$/i OR regex("\\\\(PerfLogs|Users\\\\Public|Windows\\\\Temp|ProgramData)\\\\", field=ImageFileName))
| regex("(?i)\s-(pAffID|pass\s|id\s|safe|gdel|sh\s|wall)", field=CommandLine)
| join({
    #event_simpleName=FileWritten
    | regex("(?i)\\\\(ADMIN\\$|C\\$)\\\\.*\\.(exe|dll)$", field=TargetFileName)
  }, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName])
| groupBy([UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=DistinctTargetHosts), collect([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName], limit=20), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen)])
| DistinctTargetHosts >= 2
ucs.rationale: The `-pAffID`, `-pass`, `-id`, `-safe`, `-gdel`, `-sh`, and `-wall` switches are hard-coded into LockBit's leaked builder (publicly leaked Sept 2022 and reused by every LockBit affiliate plus copycats like Bl00dy, Dark Power, and the LockBit 5.0 .pe/.linux builds in 2024-2025). No legitimate admin invokes PsExec or service-installed binaries with this exact switch combination. Pairing the SMB ADMI
